summary: Lists files and subfolders from a root folder, optionally monitoring changes and outputting selected metadata columns such as name, path, size, type, and dates.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable folder scanning and monitoring

key_params.name: rootfolder
key_params.note: Directory to scan

key_params.name: refresh
key_params.note: Monitor the filesystem folder for changes

key_params.name: refreshpulse
key_params.note: Read folder contents once on demand

key_params.name: async
key_params.note: Perform folder updates asynchronously from the main thread

key_params.name: nameformat
key_params.note: Choose whether output names include filename extensions

key_params.name: dateformat
key_params.note: Choose the date format for date columns

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Include files, folders, or both

key_params.name: folders
key_params.note: Pattern filter for included folder paths

key_params.name: names
key_params.note: Pattern filter for included item names

key_params.name: allextensions
key_params.note: Include all file extensions

key_params.name: imageextensions
key_params.note: Include TouchDesigner-supported image extensions

key_params.name: movieextensions
key_params.note: Include TouchDesigner-supported movie extensions

key_params.name: audioextensions
key_params.note: Include TouchDesigner-supported audio extensions

key_params.name: extensions
key_params.note: Custom extension pattern filter without leading periods

key_params.name: subfolders
key_params.note: Include subfolders below the root folder

key_params.name: mindepth
key_params.note: Minimum recursive depth for subfolder scanning

key_params.name: limitdepth
key_params.note: Enable a maximum recursive scan depth

key_params.name: maxdepth
key_params.note: Maximum recursive depth when Limit Depth is on

key_params.name: namecol
key_params.note: Include the item name column

key_params.name: basenamecol
key_params.note: Include the base name column without file extension

key_params.name: extensioncol
key_params.note: Include the file extension column

key_params.name: typecol
key_params.note: Include the operating-system file type column

key_params.name: sizecol
key_params.note: Include file size in bytes

key_params.name: depthcol
key_params.note: Include recursive depth from the root folder

key_params.name: foldercol
key_params.note: Include containing-folder path

key_params.name: pathcol
key_params.note: Include full item path

key_params.name: relpathcol
key_params.note: Include path relative to the root folder

key_params.name: datecreatedcol
key_params.note: Include creation date

key_params.name: datemodifiedcol
key_params.note: Include last modification date

key_params.name: dateaccessedcol
key_params.note: Include most recent access date

common_gotchas: Recursive scans over large media folders can cook slowly; limit depth and extensions for generated asset browsers.
Custom extension patterns exclude the period, so use values like txt or jpg rather than .txt or .jpg.
When Active is off, the DAT may output only headings rather than a populated listing.
Date and file metadata columns vary by operating system and filesystem.
key_concepts: Lists files and subfolders below a root folder in a DAT table.
Name, extension, type, folder, and recursive-depth parameters filter which items are included.
Column toggles choose which metadata fields are emitted, including path, size, depth, and date fields.
Asynchronous scanning can avoid main-thread stalls while delaying when updates appear.
